reason: The README describes a DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement focused on session navigation, workspace menus, breadcrumbs, and related layout changes.

summaries.zh: 替换 DSH Web 工作区侧栏，提供全局最近会话、Workspace 到 Session 的二级导航、面包屑和按日期分组的会话列表。
summaries.en: Replaces the DSH Web workspace sidebar with global recent sessions, workspace-to-session navigation, breadcrumbs, and date-grouped session lists.

capabilities: replaces the DSH Web workspace sidebar
displays recent sessions and workspace-to-session navigation
provides breadcrumbs and date-based session grouping
disables the official ui-workspace and inserts the plugin
